## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

All 7 FAILs, both PARTIALs and the notes list extracted. Every premise re-verified on `origin/main`; **one item was dropped as already-fixed** (below), and the private D13 half already had a card filed independently.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `view-authoring-live` | the documented view-**container** authoring path is inert at runtime — stored verbatim, never expanded, never served | #7736 | `domain:metadata` |
| `authoring-validation-not-persisted` | a **flat** view body is accepted, published and reported `valid:true`, then expands to nothing — the write door judges by the wire union, not the strict `ViewSchema` | #7741 | `domain:spec` |
| `org-override-registry-gate` | the **field** overlay lock is not enforced — an artifact-backed field PUT is accepted 200 (and is inert) | #7743 | `domain:metadata` |
| `expression-editors` (a) | Save is not gated on CEL errors — a parse-fault formula saves **and publishes** as the live field definition | objectstack-ai/objectui#4306 | objectui |
| `expression-editors` (b) | console emits the retired `priority` key → 422 | **not filed — already fixed** (see below) | — |
| `record-page-roundtrip` | Studio page-create seed | cited, not re-filed (objectstack-ai/objectui#4232) | objectui |
| `draft-publish-lifecycle` | the audit trail records only `save` — publish, rollback and the 409 denial never write a row | #7748 | `domain:metadata` |
| `draft-publish-lifecycle` (secondary) | a bearer-authenticated admin metadata write is stamped `actor:'system'` — `req.user`/`req.userId` unset on the `/meta` PUT path | #7749 | `domain:cli` |
| `custom-page-render-and-blocks` | showcase `my-work` authors `filters:` (plural); no `$filter` ever reaches the wire | #7750 | `domain:metadata` |
| — the general half of the above | a typo'd key inside a page component's `properties` is accepted in silence — the props bag is a passthrough record | #7751 | `needs-user-decision` |
| `page-variables-and-actions` (PARTIAL) | the vendored `packages/console/dist` is built from a pin two days behind `.objectui-sha` | #7752 | `domain:devx` |
| `permission-matrix-editor-ux` (PARTIAL) | field sub-table renders no fields | cited, not re-filed (objectstack-ai/objectui#4271) | objectui |
| Corrections & notes ×5 | one correction to #7637, two stale `automated.ref` specs, three ledger/route observations | #7753 | `domain:devx` |

The 3 PASS items produced no cards.

### `expression-editors` (b) was dropped as a stale premise — the check that caught it

The run measured console pin `09987b680` (built 2026-08-09). On objectui `origin/main` the seed is **already fixed**: `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` now carries `RETIRED_RLS_KEYS = ['priority']` and strips it on both the Add-policy seed and an edit round-trip, pinned by a dedicated `PermissionAdvancedFacets.retiredKeys.test.tsx` (three cases, including a stored policy carrying `priority` coming out clean). The fix is `5419f55` — objectui#4057, for objectstack#7130 — landed after the pin this run served. Filing it would have burned a dispatch on a solved problem.

This is the second time this batch that the vendored-console lag produced a finding that no longer exists upstream, which is exactly what **#7752** is about.

### The private half already has its card

`expression-editors`' D13 companion — the **package** door silently discarding an RLS policy (Save succeeds, no row filter persisted) — was filed independently as **objectstack-ai/objectui#4302** (`[security]`, 12:15Z) before this extraction ran. Not duplicated here. Read together with (a) and (b): all three doors into RLS authoring were broken at the served pin, and (b) is the only one already repaired.

### Worth carrying forward

**#7736 and #7741 are two halves of one seam and should be fixed together.** #7736 is "the container shape is accepted but never expanded at runtime"; #7741 is "a *different*, flat shape is also accepted and also expands to nothing." A fix to either alone leaves the door still accepting metadata it cannot serve. #7741's body notes the inline arm may be deliberate (#6391/#5599/#5074) — so the decision "make the arm require an object binding, or re-word the item" belongs with whoever takes #7736.

Provenance: maintainer standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463/#7627.
